scientific_integrity: A new exact sharp global modulus and outer-parallel comparison, derived using established qualitative weighted-perimeter continuity and monotonicity. Finite checks do not prove universal statements.
scientific_limitations: Origin-containing convex bodies, nonnegative nondecreasing radial-subharmonic weights with stated smoothness/flux assumptions; no inverse bounds or claims for nonconvex sets. The planar p>=1 coefficient is already implicit in the named prior note.
title: Sharp Hausdorff Lipschitz constants for radial-subharmonic weighted perimeters
